context: assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] title — viewscreen tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — viewscreen tip body

context: assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] title — objective-priority tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — objective-priority tip body

context: assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] title — red-alert tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — red-alert tip body
en: [Only you call Red Alert. It brings the crew to combat readiness so Helm can work the cruiser's broadside presence and Tactical can answer threats.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] title — first-visit helm tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] title — current helm rating selector guidance
assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — current helm rating selector guidance
en: [Before launch, the lobby's Station Rating selector offers Std and Simplified. Simplified assigns lateral thrust to AI while you keep the flight stick and throttle.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — first-visit helm tip body
en: [Hold the cruiser at a useful range and keep its presence where the crew needs it. The radar is your local picture; your controls are on the right.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] title — flight-stick tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — flight-stick tip body
en: [Drag the flight stick to set thrust and steering. Shape a measured orbit that keeps the cruiser in range and its broadside working.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] title — lateral-thrust tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — lateral-thrust tip body
en: [Slide sideways without turning to refine the cruiser’s bearing and keep the strongest broadside presence on the contact.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] title — impulse-drive tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — impulse-drive tip body
en: [Charge impulse for a short repositioning burst. Use it to recover range or re-establish the orbit when the situation shifts.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] title — boost-ready contextual tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — boost-ready contextual tip body
en: [Boost is available. Hold it for a brief burst when holding range or regaining the right bearing matters more than conserving reserve.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] title — first-visit tactical tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] title — current tactical rating selector guidance
assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — current tactical rating selector guidance
en: [Before launch, the lobby's Station Rating selector offers Std and Simplified. Simplified assigns the phaser banks to AI so you can focus on targeting and torpedoes.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — first-visit tactical tip body
en: [Sustain the cruiser’s presence with disciplined fire. Lock the contact, keep the phaser banks working as Helm holds the orbit, and use torpedoes when a firing solution opens.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] title — target-lock tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — target-lock tip body
en: [Tap a contact on the tactical radar to lock it. The lock gives the weapon controls their firing solution.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] title — phaser tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — phaser tip body
en: [Set the phasers to Manual when you need a deliberate shot, then fire the banks that bear. In Auto they sustain pressure while the cruiser holds position.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] title — torpedo tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — torpedo tip body
en: [Set each tube's volley target, then fire when its arc bears on the locked contact. Save a loaded volley for the opening that matters.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] title — first-visit science tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — first-visit science tip body
en: [Give the crew the picture that lets the cruiser endure. Track contacts on Sensors and keep the shield grid ready for the bearing that threatens its presence.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] title — sensor selection tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — sensor selection tip body
en: [Tap a contact on the sensor radar to select it. Its readings give the bridge the information it needs to hold the right range and bearing.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] title — shield focus tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — shield focus tip body
en: [Focus the facing under pressure to reinforce it. The other facings recover more slowly, so move the focus as the threat bearing changes.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] title — first-visit engineering tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] title — current engineering rating selector guidance
assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — current engineering rating selector guidance
en: [Before launch, the lobby's Station Rating selector offers Std and Simplified. Simplified assigns repair teams to AI while you manage the power allocation.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — first-visit engineering tip body
en: [Keep the cruiser present and durable. Balance power for the crew's current need, watch the reserve, and put repair teams where damage would break the ship's staying power.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] title — power-allocation tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — power-allocation tip body
en: [Use the controls to move reactor power between propulsion, weapons, and shields. Back the part of the ship that must hold the mission together now.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] title — repair-teams tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — repair-teams tip body

assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — waypoint tip body

assets/entities/alliance_cruiser.toml → [station.tutorial] text — hail tip body

assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — flight-stick tip body
en: [Drag the flight stick: push up to thrust, pull sideways to steer. The ship holds your last input until you move it again.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — lateral-thrust tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — lateral-thrust tip body
en: [The lower stick slides the ship sideways without turning — dodge incoming fire or drift across an enemy's aim.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — impulse-drive tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — impulse-drive tip body
en: [Impulse charges up and then hurls the ship forward in a burst. Press to start charging; press again to cancel.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — boost-ready contextual tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — boost-ready contextual tip body
en: [Boost is charged. Hold the boost button for a burst of speed — the battery drains while it runs and recharges after.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — red-alert contextual tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — red-alert contextual tip body
en: [Hostile weapon arcs now paint onto your radar. Keep the ship out of the shaded wedges while Tactical returns fire.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — first-visit captain tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — first-visit captain tip body
en: [You command the destroyer. Read the sensor scope, point the viewscreen, keep the crew's objectives straight, and call Red Alert when it's time to fight.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — viewscreen-camera tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — viewscreen-camera tip body
en: [Switch the main viewscreen between camera angles so the crew sees what matters most right now.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — sensor-scan tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — sensor-scan tip body
en: [Tap a contact on the sensor scope to scan it — its class, heading and shield strength appear below.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — objectives tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — objectives tip body
en: [Boost an objective's priority to flag it for the crew as the current focus.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — red-alert-authority tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — red-alert-authority tip body
en: [Only you can call it. Red Alert arms the crew's weapons and puts hostile firing arcs on Helm's radar.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — red-alert-active contextual tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — red-alert-active contextual tip body
en: [The ship is armed and hostile arcs are live on Helm's radar. Watch Sensors for threat details while the crew fights.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — first-visit tactical tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — first-visit tactical tip body
en: [You run the destroyer's guns. Lock a target on the radar, then work the omni phaser, forward blasters and torpedo tubes to bring it down — and keep an ear on Comms for orders.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — target-lock tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — target-lock tip body
en: [Tap a contact on the radar to lock it as your target. Blasters and torpedoes need a lock before they'll fire.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — omni-phaser tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — omni-phaser tip body
en: [The phaser fires in every direction and needs no lock. Toggle Auto/Manual, or press Fire yourself in Manual mode.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — forward-blasters tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — forward-blasters tip body
en: [Port and starboard blasters cover a narrow forward arc. Hold Fire to charge a volley, release to launch it.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — torpedo-tubes tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — torpedo-tubes tip body
en: [Fore and aft tubes load automatically. Use +/- to set how many rounds to hold loaded, then press Fire to launch them at your locked target.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — first-visit engineering tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — first-visit engineering tip body
en: [You keep the destroyer alive. Balance reactor power between Helm, Weapons and Sensors, focus shields toward incoming fire, and send repair teams to anything that's hurting.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — power-allocation tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — power-allocation tip body
en: [Use +/- to shift reactor power between groups. Pull power from what you don't need to push more into what you do.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — shield-focus tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — shield-focus tip body
en: [Focus an arc to boost its regen against the bearing you're taking fire from — every other arc regens slower while it's focused.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — repair-teams tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — repair-teams tip body
en: [Dispatch a team to a damaged system to start repairs. A team already on a job can be given priority over the others.]

context: assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] title — hull-damage contextual tip heading
assets/entities/alliance_destroyer.toml → [station.tutorial] text — hull-damage contextual tip body
en: [Something on the ship just took a hit. Check which system is hurting and get a repair team moving before it fails outright.]

en: [You set the ship's posture. Coordinate the crew and call the shots — no one else has the full picture.]

en: [Raises ship-wide combat readiness. Call it before entering a fight, not after taking the first hit.]

en: [Keep the main screen camera updated so the whole bridge sees what matters right now.]

en: [Keep the ship moving and the target in arc for Tactical. You control where the fight happens.]

context: Help modal — helm station, section 2 heading

en: [Drag to accelerate, reverse, or steer. WASD or the arrow keys steer too, as does a gamepad stick.]

context: Help modal — helm station, section 3 heading

en: [10× speed burst for rapid travel. Damage cancels it, so it's best for non-combat travel. Press Ctrl or gamepad B to charge, again to cancel.]

context: Help modal — helm station, section 4 heading
Help modal — helm station, section 4 body text
en: [Hold Shift or gamepad A for 3× speed while the battery lasts. It drains in a few seconds and takes far longer to refill, so save it for closing a gap.]

context: Help modal — helm station, section 5 heading
Help modal — helm station, section 5 body text
en: [Push your radar to the viewscreen when someone needs to see your situation.]

context: Help modal — tactical station, section 1 heading
Help modal — tactical station, section 1 body text
Help modal — tactical station, section 2 heading
Help modal — tactical station, section 2 body text
en: [Lock first — phasers and torpedoes both require an active lock by clicking on the target.]

context: Help modal — tactical station, section 3 heading
Help modal — tactical station, section 3 body text
en: [Fast and continuous but arc-limited. Enable Auto so they fire the instant the target crosses your fire arc.]

context: Help modal — tactical station, section 4 heading
Help modal — tactical station, section 4 body text
en: [Use them when on priority target. They do less damage to shields than hull, sensors can monitor target shields.]

context: Help modal — repair station, section 1 heading
Help modal — repair station, section 1 body text
en: [Keep the ship in the fight. Damaged systems degrade everyone's performance — act early.]

context: Help modal — repair station, section 2 heading
Help modal — repair station, section 2 body text
en: [Your ship health gauge, it doesn't show where the damage is, the other bridge officers should ask for repairs.]

context: Help modal — repair station, section 3 heading
Help modal — repair station, section 3 body text
en: [Dispatch teams to damaged consoles, sooner rather than later.]

context: Help modal — power station, section 1 heading
Help modal — power station, section 1 body text

context: Help modal — power station, section 2 heading

en: [Distribute 6 base points across systems. Higher level means better performance from that station.]

context: Help modal — power station, section 3 heading
Help modal — power station, section 3 body text
en: [Holds up to 2 emergency power points. Let it drain completely and everyone gets locked out for a time.]

context: Help modal — shields station, section 1 heading

en: [Absorb incoming fire and keep the ship alive.]

context: Help modal — shields station, section 2 heading

en: [Concentrate capacity on one facing to tank heavy fire by tapping it. Tap again to rebalance shields]

context: Help modal — sensors station, section 1 heading

context: Help modal — sensors station, section 2 heading

context: Help modal — navigation station, section 4 heading
Help modal — navigation station, section 4 body text

en: [Two things. Nobody works that rung while the tether is slipping, so the corridor is clear when the transfer runs. And the maintenance file on Ladder B goes to Control — not back to the operator who wrote it.]

context: Dialogue body — the hardened strike committee's three-part settlement threshold in Falling Skyway
en: [The floor has heard promises before. This time we need both undertakings and the Ladder B file in our hands before anyone votes.]

context: Dialogue body — the strike committee have enough to take to the floor in Falling Skyway
en: [That is more than anyone has offered us in six weeks. Say the word and I will put it to the floor.]

context: Response text — promising the workers safe passage in the transfer window in Falling Skyway

context: Response text — showing the committee the crew have already read the file in Falling Skyway

context: Dialogue body — the strike committee's last word after the picket is forced, Falling Skyway

context: Dialogue body — the strike committee refusing to negotiate after the force-open in Falling Skyway

context: Dialogue body — Havelock security offer to clear the picket in Falling Skyway
en: [Destroyer, Havelock Cutter. Company asset. That picket is costing the ladder a berth a minute and Control will not touch it. We can have the rung clear in ten minutes on your authorisation. Or you can go and talk to them.]

context: Response text — asking Havelock for the Ladder B maintenance file in Falling Skyway

context: Dialogue body — Havelock hand over the maintenance file in Falling Skyway

context: Response text — authorising the force-open with a warning first in Falling Skyway

context: Response text — authorising the force-open immediately in Falling Skyway
Response text — refusing Havelock the authorisation in Falling Skyway

context: Dialogue body — Havelock standing off in Falling Skyway

context: Dialogue body — Havelock acknowledging the authorisation in Falling Skyway

context: Dialogue body — the force-open outcome with nobody hurt in Falling Skyway

context: Dialogue body — the force-open outcome with one casualty in Falling Skyway

context: Dialogue body — the force-open outcome with several casualties in Falling Skyway

context: Dialogue body — the rigger opens the corroboration channel in Falling Skyway
en: [Destroyer — Tacket. I rig the transfer arm at B, or I did until six weeks ago. Committee say you have the operator's file on it. I was up there the week it says it was inspected.]

context: Response text — asking the rigger what actually happened in Falling Skyway

context: Response text — putting the rigger's channel down without answering in Falling Skyway

context: Dialogue body — the rigger waiting on an open channel in Falling Skyway

context: Dialogue body — the rigger's account of the Ladder B inspections in Falling Skyway
en: [Nobody came up. Not that week, not the week after. The collar on that arm is the one that was on it four years ago — you can see the paint line where the new one was meant to sit. Whoever signed it off did it from an office. I will say all of that to Control. I would rather Havelock did not hear my name from you first.]

context: Response text — promising to keep the rigger's name back in Falling Skyway

context: Response text — refusing the rigger cover in Falling Skyway

context: Dialogue body — the rigger signing off with the promise given in Falling Skyway
en: [Then you will have it in writing before the window opens. Mind how you go up there.]

context: Dialogue body — the rigger signing off without cover in Falling Skyway

context: Objective text — the Act 3 standing watch on the skyhook in Falling Skyway

context: Objective text — the Act 3 first tether warning in Falling Skyway
en: [Verrow is past its load limit and still taking traffic. Stabilise the head. If nobody does, it comes down.]

context: Objective text — the Act 3 second tether warning in Falling Skyway

context: Objective text — the Act 3 final tether warning in Falling Skyway

context: Dialogue body — the gang on the skyhook head check in as Act 3 opens, Falling Skyway
en: [Destroyer, Verrow head, gang boss speaking. Storm is off us and Control has put the corridor back on our berths, so we are carrying the lot on a ribbon that has been slipping since breakfast. Thought you should know there are people up here.]

context: Dialogue body — the skyhook head's first warning, Falling Skyway
en: [Destroyer, Verrow head. We are past our load limit and Control will not stop sending traffic at us. Trim is going. We can hold it a while, and a while is not all night.]

context: Dialogue body — the skyhook head's second warning, Falling Skyway
en: [Verrow head. Tension control has gone on the ribbon and the whole structure is swinging with it — you can feel it through the plates. I have a full shift up here and one lift.]

context: Dialogue body — the skyhook head's final warning, Falling Skyway
en: [Destroyer — Verrow. She will not hold station. We are riding down the ribbon. Whatever you were going to do, do it now.]

context: Response text — acknowledging the skyhook head's warning in Falling Skyway
en: [Copy, Verrow. Keep this channel open and keep talking to me.]

context: Response text — ordering the skyhook head cleared in Falling Skyway
en: [Get your people off the head. Now, and all of them.]

context: Dialogue body — the gang staying on the head after an acknowledgement, Falling Skyway
en: [Understood. We will be stood by the rail if she goes.]

context: Dialogue body — the gang coming off the head in time, Falling Skyway
en: [You are sure. Right — everybody down, transfer is off. If you are wrong about this, the corridor is yours to explain.]

context: Dialogue body — the evacuation ordered too late to clear the head, Falling Skyway
en: [Now? There is one lift and it takes six at a time. I will get who I can. The rest of us are staying with her.]

context: Dialogue body — the head already evacuated, Falling Skyway
en: [Nobody left up here to tell, Destroyer. We are on the lighter watching it with you.]

context: Dialogue body — the skyhook head stabilised and holding, Falling Skyway
en: [She is steady. Trim is back and the swing has gone out of the ribbon. That was closer than I want in the log, Destroyer.]

context: Dialogue body — the head held after being evacuated, Falling Skyway
en: [She held. And we are on a lighter looking at an empty head and a transfer nobody is running tonight. Your call. I am not saying it was the wrong one.]

context: Dialogue body — the survivor lighter calling for a tow, Falling Skyway
en: [Anyone on this channel — Verrow crew lighter. Our drive went with the head. We are in the debris with the pod somewhere off our beam and we cannot steer out of it.]

context: Evidence text — the skyhook's structural failure, Falling Skyway
en: [Skyhook Verrow failed structurally at the tether head and was lost with the corridor's only two transfer berths.]

en: [The window is open and the lift will not cover all three claims. Read Control's manifest and decide who goes.]

context: Dialogue body — Control opening a transfer window that has lift in it but not enough in Falling Skyway. {available} is the lift the chain can deliver this window, {claimed} what the three claimants have asked for between them, {shortfall} the difference
en: [Skyway Control to destroyer: transfer window is open. The head is certified and the ladder is pumping what it can pump. That comes to {available} between them, against {claimed} asked for by the three of them, and you do not need me to tell you which of those is the larger. You are short by {shortfall}. You have lift for two of them and not for three, and nothing anybody does in the next hour changes that. Nobody down here is going to make the call for you.]

context: Dialogue body — Control opening a transfer window with no lift available at all in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway Control to destroyer: transfer window is open on paper and on paper only. The head is not certified to run a climber and the ladder has nothing to put in one, so the lift available on our manifest reads nothing at all against three standing claims. Every one of them is short by the whole of it. If you want anybody off this rock before we shut, somebody has to make the chain work first.]

context: Dialogue body — Control restating a transfer manifest that moved before the captain answered anybody in Falling Skyway. {available} is the lift still unspoken for
en: [Skyway Control: manifest update, Destroyer. That board has moved and you have not answered one of them yet. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}, which is any two of the claims standing against it and not the three. None of that improves by being left.]

context: Dialogue body — Control restating a transfer manifest on which every remaining pairing still fits in Falling Skyway. {available} is the lift still unspoken for
en: [Skyway Control: manifest update. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}. Every pairing left standing on that board fits inside it, so nothing I am holding decides this for you. Whoever is still waiting, they can both go.]

context: Dialogue body — Control restating a transfer manifest on which only some pairings still fit in Falling Skyway. {available} is the lift still unspoken for
en: [Skyway Control: manifest update, and read this one carefully. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}. Some pairs standing against that fit inside it and some do not. This has stopped being any two of them and started being which two. Check the claims against the number before you promise anybody anything.]

context: Dialogue body — Control restating a transfer manifest on which several claims fit alone but no two fit together in Falling Skyway. {available} is the lift still unspoken for
en: [Skyway Control: manifest update. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}. More than one of them fits inside that on their own. No two of them fit inside it together. One name, Destroyer, and it is whichever one you can live with.]

context: Dialogue body — Control restating a transfer manifest on which only the strike committee's claim still fits in Falling Skyway. {available} is the lift still unspoken for
en: [Skyway Control: manifest update. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}, and there is exactly one claim left on this board that fits inside it — the committee's, at eighteen. Any other name you give me I will have to refuse on your behalf, and I would rather you did that yourself.]

context: Dialogue body — Control restating a transfer manifest on which only Havelock's claim still fits in Falling Skyway. {available} is the lift still unspoken for
en: [Skyway Control: manifest update. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}. The only claim still standing that fits inside that is Havelock's twenty-two. That is the arithmetic, Destroyer. I am not telling you it is the right answer.]

context: Dialogue body — Control restating a transfer manifest on which only the convoy's claim still fits in Falling Skyway. {available} is the lift still unspoken for
en: [Skyway Control: manifest update. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}. The only claim on this board that still fits inside it is the convoy's twenty-six, which is the largest number I have got. Make of that what you like.]

context: Dialogue body — Control restating a transfer manifest that can no longer honour any standing claim in Falling Skyway. {available} is the lift still unspoken for
en: [Skyway Control: manifest update, and it is the bad one. Lift still unspoken for reads {available}. Nothing left standing on this board fits inside that number. There is no name you can give me that I can put on a climber, and I am sorry to be the one saying it.]

context: Dialogue body — Control closing the transfer window in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway Control: window is shut. Anything not already at the top comes back down — that was the rule before you got here and it is not mine to bend. The manifest stands as it stands.]

context: Objective text — the Act 3 safe-passage choice in Falling Skyway

context: Response text — granting the strike committee a lift in Falling Skyway

context: Response text — refusing the strike committee a lift in Falling Skyway

context: Dialogue body — the strike committee hearing they are carried in Falling Skyway

context: Dialogue body — the strike committee hearing they are not carried in Falling Skyway
en: [Understood. We will get the gear off the arm and find ourselves a wall.]

context: Dialogue body — the strike committee standing by for a decision in Falling Skyway
en: [We will hold. We have got very good at holding.]

context: Dialogue body — Havelock ask for a lift in the transfer window in Falling Skyway
en: [Destroyer, Havelock Cutter. Twenty-two units, and I will say plainly what it buys you. This depot chain is company-run, and the next Alliance hull through this corridor books its fuel through us. Our people are staff, not cargo.]

context: Response text — granting Havelock a lift in Falling Skyway
en: [Havelock has the second slot. Load your people.]

context: Response text — refusing Havelock a lift in Falling Skyway
en: [Your staff can sit it out with everyone else. Havelock is not on the manifest.]

context: Dialogue body — Havelock hearing they are carried in Falling Skyway
en: [Noted, and logged. You will find us reasonable the next time you come through this corridor.]

context: Dialogue body — Havelock hearing they are not carried in Falling Skyway
en: [That is your decision to make. I will make quite sure it is recorded as yours.]

context: Dialogue body — Havelock standing by for a decision in Falling Skyway
en: [We will wait. We are good at waiting, Destroyer, and better at remembering.]

context: Response text — confronting Havelock with the record while protecting the witness in Falling Skyway
en: [Your file says that arm was inspected. I have somebody who was standing on it that week. You do not get their name.]

context: Response text — confronting Havelock with the record and naming the witness in Falling Skyway
en: [Your file says that arm was inspected. Rigger Tacket was standing on it that week and says nobody came up.]

context: Dialogue body — Havelock answering a confrontation with no name attached in Falling Skyway
en: [Then produce them. No? Then it is an allegation from a hull that has been on station four hours. This channel is closed to you.]

context: Dialogue body — Havelock answering a confrontation with the witness named in Falling Skyway
en: [Tacket. Yes. She is on our books — or she was. Thank you, Destroyer. You have saved our people a great deal of looking.]

context: Dialogue body — the civilian convoy ask for a lift in the transfer window in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway, Meridian, convoy lead. Twenty-six. That is four hulls and the families in them, and I know it is the biggest number on your board. I have nothing to offer you for it. I would not know what to offer.]

context: Response text — granting the convoy a lift in Falling Skyway
en: [Meridian, bring your hulls up. All four of them.]

context: Response text — refusing the convoy a lift in Falling Skyway
en: [Meridian, I cannot take you. Get your hulls tight against the rung and ride it out.]

context: Dialogue body — the convoy hearing they are carried in Falling Skyway
en: [Say again? — All four. Understood, Skyway. Understood. We are moving.]

context: Dialogue body — the convoy hearing they are not carried in Falling Skyway
en: [Understood. We will tuck in as close as they will let us. Thank you for saying it yourself.]

context: Dialogue body — the convoy standing by for a decision in Falling Skyway
en: [We will stand by. There is nowhere else to stand.]

context: Dialogue body — the strike committee asking for the last berth after the lift is gone in Falling Skyway
en: [Destroyer — committee. There is no climber and we all heard Control say so. If there is a mooring left on A with power at it we have people who will not last the night in the open.]

context: Dialogue body — Havelock asking for the last berth after the lift is gone in Falling Skyway
en: [Havelock Cutter. The head is finished, so let us be practical. A is company plant, there is one berth on it, and neither of us is going to pretend that is a coincidence.]

context: Dialogue body — the convoy asking for the last berth after the lift is gone in Falling Skyway
en: [Meridian. We are not asking for the lift any more. We are asking for a wall.]

context: Dialogue body — Control offering the one remaining Ladder A berth in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway Control: there is no lift and there is not going to be. What is left on this corridor is one mooring on Ladder A with power at it and three parties who want it. That one is not arithmetic, Destroyer. Give me a name.]

context: Dialogue body — Control with no berth left to offer at all in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway Control: no lift and Ladder A is in no state to tie anybody up either. There is nothing on this corridor to give away tonight. Log it and take your ship home.]

context: Dialogue body — Control after the last berth has been allocated in Falling Skyway
en: [The berth is allocated, Destroyer. Nothing further from this station.]

context: Response text — giving the last berth to the strike committee in Falling Skyway
Response text — giving the last berth to Havelock in Falling Skyway
Response text — giving the last berth to the convoy in Falling Skyway
Response text — holding the last berth clear in Falling Skyway
en: [The berth stays clear. Ladder A is the last working rung on this corridor and I will not have it blocked.]

context: Dialogue body — Control logging the berth to the strike committee in Falling Skyway
en: [Logged: committee to Ladder A. I will let the other two know whose call it was.]

context: Dialogue body — Control logging the berth to Havelock in Falling Skyway
en: [Logged: Havelock to Ladder A. That will read tidily in their report and badly in everyone else's.]

context: Dialogue body — Control logging the berth to the convoy in Falling Skyway
en: [Logged: Meridian to Ladder A. Four hulls into a berth built for one. They will manage or they will not.]

context: Dialogue body — Control logging the berth held clear in Falling Skyway
en: [Logged: berth held clear. Somebody up the line will want that reasoning in writing, Destroyer, and you had better have some.]

context: Dialogue body — Control standing by for a berth decision in Falling Skyway
en: [Standing by, Destroyer. The weather is not.]

context: Dialogue body — the strike committee coming through the storm largely intact in Falling Skyway
en: [Committee to Destroyer. All accounted for. Cold, and all accounted for, which is more than any of us expected when this started.]

context: Dialogue body — the strike committee coming through the storm badly in Falling Skyway
en: [Committee. We got most of them behind the pump housing before it came through. Most. Do not ask me for a number tonight, Destroyer.]

context: Dialogue body — the strike committee naming the broken safe-passage promise in Falling Skyway
en: [Committee. You gave us your word the corridor would be clear for our people in the transfer window. We wrote it down. I read it out to the floor myself and they voted on it. Then we watched that window shut with our people still standing on the rung. Whatever else you take off this rock, Destroyer, take that with you.]

context: Dialogue body — Havelock coming through the storm largely intact in Falling Skyway
en: [Havelock Cutter. Our staff sheltered aboard. The company will want a report and the report will have your name at the top of it.]

context: Dialogue body — Havelock coming through the storm badly in Falling Skyway
en: [Havelock. We lost people on that rung tonight. There will be an inquiry, and I will be asked who was in the corridor and what they did with the lift.]

context: Dialogue body — the convoy coming through the storm largely intact in Falling Skyway
en: [Meridian. Four hulls, all still here. Scoured back to the frames and all still here. We will take that.]

context: Dialogue body — the convoy coming through the storm badly in Falling Skyway
en: [Meridian. We lost the third hull. Everyone aboard her was somebody's. I am not going to say anything else on an open channel.]

context: Dialogue body — Control closing the window with the committee and the convoy carried in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway Control, closing the window. Manifest reads: strike committee carried, Meridian convoy carried, Havelock Operations not carried. The corridor is shut and the record stands as flown. Every party on it now knows exactly what this ship decided when it could only decide once.]

context: Dialogue body — Control closing the window with the committee and Havelock carried in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway Control, closing the window. Manifest reads: strike committee carried, Havelock Operations carried, Meridian convoy not carried. The corridor is shut. The two parties with something to trade are off this rock and the one with nothing is still on it, and it is filed in those words.]

context: Dialogue body — Control closing the window with Havelock and the convoy carried in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway Control, closing the window. Manifest reads: Havelock Operations carried, Meridian convoy carried, strike committee not carried. The corridor is shut. The people who told you what was wrong with this ladder are the people still standing on it.]

context: Dialogue body — Control closing the window with only one claim carried in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway Control, closing the window. Manifest reads one claim carried out of three, against lift that would have taken two. The corridor is shut, and that difference is filed against this ship rather than against the ladder.]

context: Dialogue body — Control closing the window with nothing carried in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway Control, closing the window. Manifest reads nothing carried. There was lift in this window and it went up the ribbon empty. The corridor is shut and all three claims stand unmet.]

context: Dialogue body — Control closing a window with no lift after a berth was allocated in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway Control, closing the window. No lift ran in this corridor tonight. One mooring on Ladder A was allocated, two claims were not, and the rest of it is weather and paperwork. Log it and go.]

context: Dialogue body — Control closing a window with no lift and no berth allocated in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway Control, closing the window. No lift, no mooring allocated, three claims standing. Nothing left this rock tonight and nothing on this corridor is better than it was when you arrived. The window is shut. Go home.]

context: Evidence text — Havelock put to their own maintenance record, Falling Skyway
en: [Havelock Operations were put to their own maintenance record on the open channel during the transfer window.]

context: Evidence text — the strike committee left in the corridor for the storm, Falling Skyway
en: [The strike committee were not carried in the transfer window and sheltered on the Ladder B rung. There were casualties.]

context: Evidence text — Havelock staff left in the corridor for the storm, Falling Skyway
en: [Havelock Operations staff were not carried in the transfer window and sheltered aboard their own hulls. There were casualties.]

context: Evidence text — the convoy left in the corridor for the storm, Falling Skyway
en: [Convoy Meridian were not carried in the transfer window and rode the corridor out in the open. There were casualties.]

context: Evidence text — the filed evidence bundle followed by naming the witness to Havelock, Falling Skyway
en: [The Ladder B scan discrepancy and Rigger Tacket's corroboration were filed with Control unedited. The crew later named Tacket to Havelock.]

context: Evidence text — the filed evidence bundle with the witness protected from Havelock, Falling Skyway
en: [The Ladder B scan discrepancy and Rigger Tacket's corroboration were filed with Control unedited. The crew did not name Tacket to Havelock.]

context: Evidence text — the discrepancy established but its evidence bundle not filed, Falling Skyway
en: [The crew established Ladder B's scan discrepancy but did not file the discrepancy and worker account with Control.]

context: Evidence text — no discrepancy established at all, Falling Skyway
en: [No discrepancy was established between Ladder B's condition and the operator's file on it. The claim stands unexamined.]

context: Evidence text — every commitment kept, Falling Skyway
en: [Every commitment this captain gave in the Skyway corridor was kept.]

context: Evidence text — at least one commitment broken, Falling Skyway
en: [At least one commitment this captain gave in the Skyway corridor was broken.]

context: Evidence text — no commitments made at all, Falling Skyway
en: [This captain gave no commitments in the Skyway corridor.]

context: Dialogue body — the strike committee reacting to the transfer manifest moving in Falling Skyway
en: [Control's board just moved. Are we still on that manifest or are we not?]

context: Dialogue body — Havelock reacting to the transfer manifest moving in Falling Skyway
en: [The manifest has changed since we last spoke, Destroyer. Say plainly whether Havelock is on it.]

context: Dialogue body — the convoy reacting to the transfer manifest moving in Falling Skyway
en: [Skyway — Meridian. Something just came off that board. Is that us?]

context: Dialogue response — authorise Tactical force against the Havelock picket, Falling Skyway

context: Dialogue body — the Havelock picket refusing to stand off, Falling Skyway

context: Dialogue body — the Havelock picket agreeing to leave the lane, Falling Skyway
